messages.subject: Using font-awesome in server
parts:
I am building an app that uses icons from font-awesome in a ggplot2 object in the server. Everything works fine until I publish it using shinyapps.io, where I get an error saying that it cannot find "font-awesome".
Does anyone know if it is possible to use the fonts for a published app?

Thanks!

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Using font-awesome in server
parts: You might try the extrafont package, whose font_import should let you use a .ttf file.
